summary: Flathead/Lake County, MT lookout site on the Flathead NF: a log cabin listed for 1920 and an L-4 cab for 1948, both gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Marked gone by firelookout.com and by the Forest Fire Lookout Association state list, which files it under Ground.

events.note: Log cabin listed for 1920, per firelookout.com
L-4 cab listed for 1948; the source does not say whether it replaced the cabin

evidence.supports: 1920 log cabin; 1948 L-4 cab; second L-4 cab atop Gildart; site gone
evidence.quote: 1920: log cabin. 1948: L-4 cab. Also another L-4 cab 2 miles south atop Gildart. Gone.

evidence.supports: 8 miles southwest of the Spotted Bear Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 8 miles southwest of Spotted Bear R.S.

evidence.supports: on the Flathead and Lake county line
state list files the Flathead/Lake site under Ground and marks it gone
a second Thunderbolt Mountain is in Jefferson and Powell counties
that second Thunderbolt Mountain is a separate tower site with its own coordinates

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the firelookout.com page and the state list. Two searches and several reads found no staffing, fire or NRHP source for this site, and nothing says what remains on the peak. Do not merge with the Powell/Jefferson County Thunderbolt Mountain (Deer Lodge NF, firelookout.com/mt/thunderboltmtn.html), which is a separate 20-foot pole L-4 tower site, nor with the Idaho Thunderbolt Mountain Lookout on the NHLR (Boise NF). The Gildart L-4 cab two miles south is named only in passing and has no separate record here. The 'Gone' on the firelookout.com page carries no date.
